name: The Garden
source:
Blinking awake, you feel something odd–bunny ears. That’s definitely not normal. And the place around you? Completely unfamiliar. Hold on… isn’t that Ren?

[From [url=https://www.newgrounds.com/portal/view/639264]Newgrounds[/url]]
translation:
眨眼醒来，你感觉到了一些奇怪的东西——兔子耳朵。这绝对不正常。那你周围的地方呢？完全陌生。等等……那不是雷恩吗？

[来自[url=https://www.newgrounds.com/portal/view/639264]Newgrounds[/url]]
